cues.en: Here we are at the computer,
cues.zh: 我们现在来到电脑前，

cues.en: and we wanna look at two things. The first, of course, is what it's like to actually build a mission critical app. We're gonna do that here. But before we do that, I wanna show you what it's like to work in the next computer's productivity environment, an environment that has much, much better networking in PCs and Macs and much, much better productivity apps that let people work together as groups and really increases their group productivity and collaboration. So let's take a look at that first, and then we'll get to building an actual custom app that can interoperate with these off the shelf productivity apps. So let's take a look.
cues.zh: 主要看两件事。第一件当然是真正构建一个关键业务应用是什么体验，我们马上就会在这里演示。但在那之前，我想先带大家看看在 NeXT 电脑的生产力环境中工作是什么感觉——这个环境的网络能力远超 PC 和 Mac，并且拥有更好的生产力应用，能让人们以团队形式协同工作，真正大幅提升团队生产力和协作效率。所以我们先来看看这个，然后再来实际构建一个能与这些现成生产力应用互操作的自定义应用。我们马上开始吧。

cues.en: For those of you that have never seen Next step before, Next step has your menus,
cues.zh: 没用过 Next step 的人可能不知道，Next step 有菜单栏、

cues.en: your windows,
cues.zh: 窗口，

cues.en: and a thing over here called the dock,
cues.zh: 还有这边叫 Dock 的东西，

cues.en: which you can move out of the way if you want to. And the dock is really useful for keeping the applications you use most often
cues.zh: 你可以按需把它挪开。Dock 非常实用，能让你最常用的应用

cues.en: in constant view, always on the top. So I can grab an application like this X terminal emulator and just click it into the dock here, whichever ones I find the most useful to me. And the dock will always stay on the top so I can find them very quickly.
cues.zh: 一直可见、始终置顶。所以我可以像这样抓住一个应用，比如这个 X 终端模拟器，点一下把它放进 Dock，挑对我最有用的那些。Dock 会始终置顶，我就能很快找到它们。

cues.en: Also, please note that when I move around these Next Step windows, the entire contents of the window comes with me. This gets extremely important when we have color images.
cues.zh: 另外请注意，当我移动这些 Next Step 窗口时，窗口里的所有内容都会跟着一起移动。处理彩色图像时，这一点就非常重要。

cues.en: If
cues.zh: 如果

cues.en: this was a Macintosh or a PC,
cues.zh: 这是 Macintosh 或 PC，

cues.en: moving around these full color images would take until next week for them to all repaint.
cues.zh: 移动这些全彩图像要等到下周才能全部重新绘制出来。

cues.en: And so rather than just moving the outlines, moving
cues.zh: 所以，我们不只是移动窗口轮廓，而是让

cues.en: the entire images along with us really is fantastic
cues.zh: 整个图像都跟着一起移动，这确实是个很棒的

cues.en: benefit if you're working in publishing or some other area that demands that you use color imagery.
cues.zh: 优势，尤其是你从事出版或其他需要使用彩色图像的工作时。

cues.en: In addition,
cues.zh: 此外，

cues.en: rather than just having the option to quit things, because we're a full multitasking
cues.zh: 除了直接退出应用之外，因为我们是一个构建在 Unix 之上的

cues.en: system on top of Unix,
cues.zh: 完整多任务系统，

cues.en: we can hide things. And I push hide here, and those pictures all hide behind their icon, which happens to be over here in the dock. And I can click and you can see how fast the graphics in Next Step are.
cues.zh: 我们还可以把它们隐藏起来。我点击这里的隐藏，那些图片就全隐藏到了它们的图标后面，也就是这里的 Dock 栏。我点一下，你们就能看到 Next Step 的图形响应有多快。

cues.en: Now,
cues.zh: 现在，

cues.en: this is the application where I find all of my files and other things. I'm gonna hide that for now. And we're gonna use the mail as the spine of our demo here. This is standard NextMail, which is bundled with Next Step.
cues.zh: 我就是在这个应用里查找所有文件和其他内容的。我先把它藏起来。接下来我们将用邮件作为这次演示的主线。这是 Next Step 自带的标准 NextMail。

cues.en: And,
cues.zh: 而且，

cues.en: these are all the mail messages that have come in. And when I click on one, as you see, it's,
cues.zh: 这些就是收到的所有邮件。当我点击其中一封时，如你所见，它……

cues.en: contents is put in this window down here. We have smooth scrolling throughout the system. You'll see that a lot as well. In this mail message, I have postscript of any font or size.
cues.zh: 内容会显示在下方这个窗口里。整个系统都有平滑滚动效果，你还会经常看到这一点。在这封邮件里，我可以使用任意字体、任意字号的 PostScript。

cues.en: I have graphics. I have a signature.
cues.zh: 我可以插入图形，还可以有签名。

cues.en: And above here, I have a picture of the person that sent this mail message, in this case, myself, the date and the time it was sent, and a bunch of buttons.
cues.zh: 在这上面，还有发件人的照片——这封就是我发的，还有发送的日期和时间，以及一排按钮。

cues.en: As an example, if I want to forward this mail message to somebody, I can hit Compose.
cues.zh: 比如，我想把这封邮件转发给某个人，就可以点击“撰写”。

cues.en: And I can just push forward, and it'll put the contents of this mail message in here, as you can see.
cues.zh: 然后点击“转发”，这封邮件的内容就会显示在这里，你看。

cues.en: I can reply, in which case it'll reply to me. I can look up addresses on the network. I can go back here and I can look up, let's say, group of people, the whole marketing department I can send this to. I can CC the marketing department.
cues.zh: 我可以回复，这样就会给我回复。我可以在网络上查找地址，也可以回到这里，查找一组人，比如整个市场部，把邮件发给他们。我还可以抄送整个市场部。

cues.en: And I can even add voice annotation by clicking on what we call lip service,
cues.zh: 我甚至可以通过点击所谓的 lip service 来添加语音批注，

cues.en: and I can record something. Hey, can you check this out and let me know what you think? Thanks. Bye.
cues.zh: 然后录一段话：“嘿，你能看一下这个并告诉我你的想法吗？谢谢，拜。”

cues.en: And I can insert it, and you'll see the lips are inserted here. The recipient just simply clicks on these lips and plays the message.
cues.zh: 我可以把它插入进来，你会看到这里出现了一个嘴唇图标。收件人只需点击这个嘴唇，就能播放这条留言。

cues.en: Hey, can you check this out and let me know what you think? Thanks. Bye.
cues.zh: “嘿，你能看一下这个并告诉我你的想法吗？谢谢，拜。”

cues.en: And almost all of the Next Step applications can be voice annotated just this easily. You deliver the mail by just pushing this button right here. And we found that this mail system is so easy to use that executives can use it without reading manuals, which is sort of our test of ease of use.
cues.zh: 几乎所有的 NeXTSTEP 应用程序都可以这么轻松地添加语音批注。点击这里的这个按钮就能发送邮件。我们发现这套邮件系统用起来非常简单，连高管都不用看手册就能上手，这也是我们检验易用性的标准。

cues.en: This person wanted to include a color photograph in their mail message, so they just scanned it in on any one of the several scanners available and dropped it in mail.
cues.zh: 这个人想在邮件里附上一张彩色照片，于是就用几台可用扫描仪中的任意一台扫描了一下，然后拖进邮件里。

cues.en: Next is fully drag and drop. So if I click on this, I can just drag out this image and drag it into another application if that's what I wanted to do. Now, in addition to just speech,
cues.zh: 接下来是完全的拖放功能。如果我点一下这里，就能把这幅图拖出来，拖进另一个应用程序，如果我想这么做的话。现在，除了语音之外，

cues.en: Next Step supports full CD quality sound.
cues.zh: Next Step 支持完整 CD 音质的声音。

cues.en: This happens to be a picture of my my young son,
cues.zh: 这正好是我小儿子的照片，

cues.en: and, we can actually play music here.
cues.zh: 而且，我们实际上可以在这里播放音乐。

cues.en: And it's nice to know that your system is capable of it.
cues.zh: 而且很高兴知道你的系统具备这种能力。

cues.en: Now, what about applications?
cues.zh: 那么，应用程序呢？

cues.en: Well, when we wanna send an attachment, what we do is as follows. Let's go ahead and send a spreadsheet. You say, check this out.
cues.zh: 当我们想发送附件时，会这样做。我们来发送一个电子表格。你可以说：“看看这个。”

cues.en: And so we can read this more clearly, we'll bring up our
cues.zh: 为了看得更清楚，我们来打开

cues.en: font object
cues.zh: 字体对象

cues.en: and, this is an object for controlling all the fonts in the system. I happen to have a lot of fonts in here. I can simply set Helvetica to to a bigger font by pushing this. Or I can go down and get a font that I really like, which is stencil, only comes in bold, but I'll say stencil 36.
cues.zh: 这是一个用来控制系统中所有字体的对象。我这里正好有很多字体。只要按一下这里，就能把 Helvetica 调大。或者我可以往下找一个很喜欢的字体——Stencil。它只有粗体，我就选 Stencil 36。

cues.en: Check this out. That'll make sure it gets red at the other end. And now, I'll go to my, file viewer, which is where I have all of my files.
cues.zh: 看这个。这能确保对方那边能读到。现在，打开我的文件查看器，我的所有文件都在这儿。

cues.en: And,
cues.zh: 然后，

cues.en: I'll click on spreadsheets.
cues.zh: 我点击电子表格。

cues.en: And I'll just go grab a spreadsheet and drag it down into the mail window. That's all I have to do. And it puts it wherever the cursor was. So, if I wanna put another one between the words check and this, I just put my cursor there, go grab another spreadsheet and drag it down, it just sticks it in there. And I can have as many different documents of any type that I want, as many lips with voice annotations as I want in any mail message. And I can put another space here if I want to, whatever, and just deliver it. And the recipient
cues.zh: 我直接拖一个电子表格放到邮件窗口里，这就搞定了。光标在哪，它就放在哪。所以，如果我想在“check”和“this”这两个词之间再放一个，只要把光标移过去，再拽一个电子表格下来，就直接插进去了。任何类型的文档我想放多少就放多少，任何带语音批注的片段在任何邮件里也想加多少就加多少。如果愿意，我还能在这里再加个空格什么的，然后直接发送。接收者

cues.en: ends up with something that looks like this,
cues.zh: 最终看到的效果就会像这样，

cues.en: where the spreadsheet in this document, in this case, is just embedded right between some words and above a picture of a Ferrari. And they just double click on it, which launches the parent application, in this case Lotus Improv, and brings up the spreadsheet.
cues.zh: 这份文档里的电子表格，在这里就嵌在几行文字之间、一张法拉利图片的上方。他们只需双击它，就会启动父应用——这里是 Lotus Improv——然后把电子表格调出来。

cues.en: We don't have time to demo all of Lotus Improv, but it's a pretty remarkable spreadsheet.
cues.zh: 我们没时间演示整个 Lotus Improv，但它是相当出色的电子表格。

cues.en: Okay. So that's Improv. But more importantly,
cues.zh: 好，这就是 Improv。但更重要的是，

cues.en: we got our Improv model right through the mail without any real headaches.
cues.zh: 我们通过邮件顺利拿到了 Improv 模型，没遇到什么麻烦。

cues.en: Now,
cues.zh: 现在，

cues.en: we have the same for WordPerfect.
cues.zh: WordPerfect 也是一样。

cues.en: Now, here's a WordPerfect document that I just got in the mail. As you know,
cues.zh: 这是我刚收到的一份 WordPerfect 文档。你们知道，

cues.en: version of WordPerfect on the next computer is the most advanced version of WordPerfect.
cues.zh: 下一台电脑上的 WordPerfect 版本是最先进的版本。

cues.en: And in addition to that
cues.zh: 除此之外，

cues.en: is total WYSIWYG.
cues.zh: 它完全支持所见即所得。

cues.en: What you see is what you get. So, here's our documents that is totally compatible with the other versions of WordPerfect and yet I can see everything. I can take the picture, I can move it around and we'll see the text instantly reformat.
cues.zh: 所见即所得。我们的文档与其他版本的 WordPerfect 完全兼容，而且我能看到所有内容。我可以选中图片，移动它，文字就会立即重新排版。

cues.en: I can ask
cues.zh: 我可以要求

cues.en: to make the text three columns.
cues.zh: 把文本排成三栏。

cues.en: Now my picture's a little too big so I can resize the picture here to make it a little bit smaller.
cues.zh: 现在我的图片有点太大了，所以我可以在这里调整图片大小，让它变小一点。

cues.en: And I can move it from this column over to this column or I can put it between these two columns if I want. And people that see this after using WordPerfect on other platforms are amazed that
cues.zh: 我还可以把它从这一栏移到那一栏，或者只要我想，也可以把它放在这两栏之间。在其他平台上用过 WordPerfect 的人看到这个都会惊叹，

cues.en: your documents can really look like this.
cues.zh: 你的文档居然真的能做成这样。

cues.en: I wanna show you another feature of the Next environment.
cues.zh: 我还想给大家展示 NeXT 环境的另一个功能。

cues.en: I'm going to pick a word like preserve and I'm going to go over here to this menu called services.
cues.zh: 我选一个词，比如 preserve，然后到这个叫 services 的菜单。

cues.en: Now, the services menu is rather unique in that it appears in every application,
cues.zh: services 菜单的独特之处在于它出现在每个应用中，

cues.en: but the contents of the services menu is not owned by any one application, it's owned by Next Step. And any other application can register themselves as a service and the appropriate ones will pop up in the services menu of all the other applications.
cues.zh: 但 services 菜单的内容不属于任何单个应用，而是属于 Next Step。任何其他应用都可以把自己注册为一项服务，相应的服务会出现在所有其他应用的 services 菜单中。

cues.en: So as an example, I picked the word preserve in WordPerfect and I go up and one of the services is Webster's Ninth Collegiate Dictionary in Thesaurus, which we bundle with NextDepth. So I say define in Webster's,
cues.zh: 举个例子，我在 WordPerfect 里选中 preserve 这个词，然后打开菜单，其中一项服务是《韦氏第九版大学词典与同义词词典》，它随 NextDepth 一起提供。我选择“在韦氏词典中查找”。

cues.en: it'll launch Webster's, throw that word in, and in a second or two, the definition and the thesaurus for preserve
cues.zh: 它就会启动韦氏词典，把这个词输入进去，一两秒后，preserve 的释义和同义词词典内容

cues.en: will pop up on my screen. And here's the definition
cues.zh: 就会显示在屏幕上。这是释义，

cues.en: and there's the thesaurus entries.
cues.zh: 这里是同义词词条。

cues.en: And we'll come back to this again
cues.zh: 我们稍后还会

cues.en: in a little while.
cues.zh: 再回来看这个。

cues.en: Okay. Now, what I wanna show you, a little bit of the networking. When we designed Next Step, we looked at the networking that workstations had and it was substantially better than was available on PCs or Macintoshes.
cues.zh: 好的。现在我想给大家展示一点网络功能。我们在设计 NeXTSTEP 时，审视了工作站所具备的网络能力，它明显优于当时 PC 或 Macintosh 上的水平。

cues.en: However, you had to be a rocket scientist to figure out how to use it. So we asked ourselves, could we use this much more powerful workstation networking and yet make it even easier than a Macintosh to use? And we think we accomplished this, and let me show it to you and you can tell me what you think.
cues.zh: 然而，你得是顶尖专家才能搞懂怎么用它。所以我们自问：能否利用这种强大得多的工作站网络能力，同时让它用起来比 Macintosh 还要简单？我们认为自己做到了，现在我演示给大家看看，你们来评判一下。

cues.en: Now, this is some... A message that I've gotten from Gary. Hey, Ross Pro was in the Wall Street Journal last week.
cues.zh: 这是……一封我从 Gary 那里收到的消息。嘿，Ross Pro 上周登上了《华尔街日报》。

cues.en: Just go over the network to my home directory, I'm on the marketing server, to see the digital librarian bookshelf with last week's Wall Street Journal issues.
cues.zh: 直接通过网络连到我的主目录，我在市场部的服务器上，去看看数字图书管理员书架里上周的《华尔街日报》期刊。

cues.en: Now, the digital librarian is an application that we also bundle with Next Step where you can drop any text you've ever written into it,
cues.zh: 数字图书管理员是我们随 Next Step 一起打包的应用，你可以把写过的任何文本丢进去，

cues.en: your policy manual, your love letters, what have you, and it will build a keyword index to let you find stuff very quickly. And what we've done is we put some Wall Street Journal data into the digital librarian from January,
cues.zh: 你的政策手册、你的情书，随便什么，它会建立一个关键词索引，让你能非常快地找到东西。我们做的是把一月份的一些《华尔街日报》数据放进了数字图书管理员里，

cues.en: and
cues.zh: 然后

cues.en: Gary is asking me to go over the network to find his home directory
cues.zh: Gary 让我通过网络去找到他的主目录

cues.en: and to take a look at it. Well, how do I do that? I go back here to my file viewer. Now, everyone on the NeXT system has a home directory. This is my home directory. It's where I put all my stuff. And Gary's asking me to go find his. He's on the marketing server. Well, to go out over the network, I go back to my computer
cues.zh: 去看一看。那我该怎么做呢？我回到这里的文件查看器。NeXT 系统上的每个人都有主目录。这是我的主目录，我所有东西都放在这里。Gary 让我去找他的。他在市场部的服务器上。要连到网络上，我回到我的电脑

cues.en: and I have this globe right here. And I click on this globe and it shows me everything on the network.
cues.zh: 我这里有个地球仪。点一下，就能看到网络上的所有内容。

cues.en: And so I go into the demo server here
cues.zh: 我现在进入这个演示服务器

cues.en: and it'll show me the different departments. And I go into the marketing department and sure enough, there's Gary. Now, everyone else's home directory shows up as his little neighborhood, so I don't get him confused with my own.
cues.zh: 它会显示不同的部门。我进入市场部，果然看到了 Gary。其他人的主目录都显示成各自的小街区，这样我就不会把他的和自己的搞混。

cues.en: And sure enough, in Gary's home directory, there's the Wall Street Journal bookshelf.
cues.zh: 果然，在 Gary 的主目录里，有一排《华尔街日报》。

cues.en: Now,
cues.zh: 现在，

cues.en: that every time I clicked on something, it put a copy of it in this little horizontal scrolling window up here.
cues.zh: 我每次点击一个东西，它就会复制一份，放到上方这个小小的水平滚动窗口里。

cues.en: So I can see the entire trail or history or path that I've traversed to get there. Out of my computer, over the network, over the demo server, in the marketing,
cues.zh: 这样我能看到一路走到这里所经过的完整轨迹、历史记录或路径。从我的电脑出发，穿过网络，穿过演示服务器，进入营销目录，

cues.en: into Gary's home directory, and to the digital librarian bookshelf. Now, if I wanna go back to marketing, I just go click on this like a button and boom, I'm back there.
cues.zh: 再进到 Gary 的主目录，然后来到数字图书管理员书架。现在，如果我想回到营销目录，只要像点按钮一样点一下这里，瞧，我就回去了。

cues.en: And it's incredibly fast to navigate around the network this way.
cues.zh: 用这种方式在网络中导航非常快。

cues.en: In addition to that, it's kind of like tuning a radio station on my radio. I've just finished tuning the radio station, I. E, finding Gary.
cues.zh: 除此之外，这有点像在我的收音机上调电台。我刚调好电台，也就是找到了 Gary。

cues.en: If I'm going to listen to this radio station a lot, I kinda like to program a button just like I do on my car radio. Well, I can do that. What I do is I just take Gary's home directory and drag a copy of it anywhere up here on what we call the shelf, and it programs a button for me. Now, my home directory is put up here automatically for me. So if I get lost or if I wanna go home quickly, just go push on it and blamo, I'm home. But now, if I wanna go back to Gary, I just push this. And whether Gary's next door or in Tokyo, I'm back to Gary's system. And you can see how fast it is.
cues.zh: 如果我要经常听这个电台，我就像在车载收音机上那样，给它编一个按钮。嗯，我可以做到。做法就是，我直接拿 Gary 的主目录，把它的副本拖到上面这里我们称之为搁架的地方，它就为我编好了一个按钮。现在，我的主目录会自动放在这里。所以如果我迷路了，或者想快速回家，只要按一下它，砰，我就到家了。但现在，如果我想回到 Gary 那里，我只要按这个。不管 Gary 就在隔壁还是在东京，我都能回到 Gary 的系统。你能看到这有多快。

cues.zh: 如你所见，

cues.en: again, all of this just works.
cues.zh: 这一切都能直接生效。

cues.en: One of the other things, that we've done with Next Step Release three point o is we've actually built in some three-dimensional
cues.zh: 我们在 Next Step 3.0 版本中做的另一件事，是内置了一些三维

cues.en: graphics.
cues.zh: 图形功能。

cues.en: We have built in
cues.zh: 我们内置了

cues.en: Pixar's RenderMan photorealistic rendering software, which can produce the most photorealistic
cues.zh: 皮克斯的 RenderMan 照片级真实感渲染软件，它能生成最逼真的

cues.en: rendered images
cues.zh: 渲染图像

cues.en: from three d models.
cues.zh: 由三维模型生成。

cues.en: In addition to that, we've built in some real time three d graphics, interactive RenderMan. We've taken photorealistic RenderMan and made a version that will run interactively on the screen.
cues.zh: 除此之外，我们还内置了实时三维图形，也就是交互式 RenderMan。我们把照片级真实感的 RenderMan 改造成了一个能在屏幕上实时交互运行的版本。

cues.en: And so I can, bring up a cube here,
cues.zh: 我可以在这里调出一个立方体，

cues.en: which will...
cues.zh: 它会……

cues.en: I can take and actually put behind
cues.zh: 我可以把它放到

cues.en: these two d images.
cues.zh: 这两张二维图像的后面。

cues.en: And I can actually then rotate it. And this cube is being rendered in real time as we watch it and being composited onto a two d image
cues.zh: 我甚至还可以旋转它。在我们观看的同时，这个立方体正在被实时渲染，并合成到一张 2D 图像上，

cues.en: behind the car and behind that last tree.
cues.zh: 位于汽车后方以及最后一棵树的后面。

cues.en: Now,
cues.zh: 现在，

cues.en: we believe that over the coming years, three-dimensional graphics may play a very important role in business as we try to visualize more and more complex data in ways that we can assimilate very rapidly.
cues.zh: 我们相信在未来几年里，随着我们试图以更快速吸收的方式将日益复杂的数据可视化，3D 图形可能会在商业中扮演非常重要的角色。

cues.en: But in any event, the purpose of this last thing was to show you that to build very rich graphical apps in Next step is no different than anything else. Most of the work is already done for you.
cues.zh: 但无论如何，最后一个演示的目的就是向大家展示，在 NeXTSTEP 中构建极其丰富的图形应用与做其他开发并无二致，绝大部分工作都已经被预先做好了。

cues.en: So that concludes the demo I wanted to do, and I hope you get a feeling of how rich the Next Step environment is, how easy to use it is so that mere mortals can use this very, very powerful piece of software,
cues.zh: 到此，我想做的演示就结束了。希望你能感受到 Next Step 环境有多么丰富、多么易用，让普通人也能使用这款极其强大的软件，

cues.en: and how it's possible to create and deploy mission critical custom apps in a fraction of the time than ever before possible and to do all three simultaneously.
cues.zh: 以及如何以过去无法企及的极短时间创建和部署关键任务的自定义应用，并且三者同时做到。

cues.en: Thank you.
cues.zh: 谢谢。
